integrity: The group-generation criteria are derived from the dihedral presentation. They give an exact isolated-plus-complete-multipartite decomposition for n=p^k. A false-twin forcing analysis classifies every zero forcing profile. Explicit rank-two and rank-three bilinear representations give upper bounds, and a two-dimensional isotropic-line obstruction proves the rank-three lower bound for k>=2.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to odd-prime-power rotation orders n=p^k.
The p=2 case has broader prior coverage through generating graphs of two-generated finite 2-groups.
General n with multiple prime factors has a more complicated unitary-Cayley reflection subgraph.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
The complete-multipartite zero forcing number itself is broader prior coverage; the strengthened content is the full polynomial, minimizer classification, and rank/nullity transition.
title: Zero forcing and minimum rank in prime-power dihedral generating graphs
